title: Relative timing of daily heart-rate and RMSSD rhythms does not improve exploratory heart-failure transfer across Holter databases
abstract: Adding the signed sine of the 24-hour harmonic phase lag between log mean NN and log RMSSD changed external heart-failure-label Brier loss by +0.00025 (joint bootstrap 95% [-0.00253, 0.01074]); incremental predictive benefit was not established.
